project.title: MESBG List Builder
project.introduction: A free, community-driven companion for Middle-earth Strategy Battle Game players. Build your armies, explore profiles and rules, and spend less time managing lists and more time enjoying the hobby.
project.history: MESBG List Builder started as a personal project to make creating and managing army lists a little easier. Over time, it grew into a tool used by players throughout the Middle-earth community, shaped by their feedback, suggestions, and contributions.
project.today: The application is currently being rebuilt from the ground up. Much of the work focuses on bringing familiar functionality back on a more maintainable foundation, while improving the experience and making room for future features. Development remains a hobby project, driven by a shared enthusiasm for the game.
project.disclaimer: MESBG List Builder is an independent, fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Games Workshop.

team.title: Meet the team
team.description: MESBG List Builder is a passion project brought to life by a small team of dedicated Middle-earth enthusiasts. From writing code to maintaining game data, each of us contributes in our own way to making the tool better for the community.

supporters.title: Our supporters
supporters.description: A special thank you to everyone helping make continued development of MESBG List Builder possible.
